description.add-cards: Search for cards or add a whole deck. Their art is searched for automatically.
description.choose-cards: Search for a card or add a deck, and the sheet shows up here.
description.choose-order: Search for a card or add a deck, and the order list shows up here.
description.choose-tool: Choose a tool for the table.
description.cut-lines: A hairline along every card edge to cut on.
description.foil: Costs extra and cannot be decided per card.
description.foil-impossible: Plastic comes in no foil finish.
description.import-xml: Import the file into MPCFill under “Add Cards → XML”.
description.life-counter: Life totals for the whole table or just your own, every tile turned towards its seat.
description.more-tools-soon: More helpers for the table are on their way.
description.mpc-fill: Have proxies printed by MakePlayingCards, as a list for MPCFill.
description.mpc-order: Pick the art for every card out of the community drives, then download the order file.
description.no-art-hint: The drives hold no image for this card. You can upload one at MPCFill — or the card stays out of the order file.
description.nothing-picked: No card on the list yet.
description.nothing-to-order: No card has art yet — without that, nothing goes into the file.
description.only-proxies: Loads only the cards the deck marks as proxies.
description.order-too-large: More than {{cards}} cards do not fit into one order — split the list up.
description.paste-into-mpc-fill: Paste it into MPCFill under “Add Cards → Text” and submit.
description.pick-art_other: {{count}} images in the drives. The one you pick goes into the order file.
description.print-backs: Two-sided cards go on the sheet with both faces.
description.print-scale: Nine cards at their real size per A4 sheet. Set the print dialog to 100% scale.
description.proxy-printer: Cards at their real size on A4, ready to cut out.
description.reset-game_one: Puts you back on {{life}} life. This cannot be undone.
description.reset-game_other: Puts every player back on {{life}} life and clears the commander damage. This cannot be undone.
description.skip-basics: Basics stay off the sheet, everyone has those in a box already.
